transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, honestly, I'm mostly here because HR at work and my sister keep saying I've gotten too thin. I don't really see it like that, though. From my side, I just see that my suits are fitting a lot sharper for my sales calls. I mean, my weight has kept dropping since the divorce, sure, but they're the ones who really pushed me to come talk to someone about it.
Are you afraid of gaining weight or becoming heavier?

Yeah, I guess I am. I mean... if I step on the scale and it's even a pound higher after a client dinner, or like a weekend out in Miami, I get this sudden panic. It just feels like I'm losing control. So right away, I start planning exactly how I'm going to cut back the next day to fix it.
What are your current height and weight?

Well, I'm actually not sure of the exact numbers right now. I mean, I know my weight has been dropping, like I mentioned, but I don't have the specific number on the scale to give you today. And honestly, I haven't had my height officially measured in a really long time, so I don't want to just guess at it.
Do you deliberately restrict how much you eat in order to prevent gaining weight?

Yeah, I do. Most days I just keep it to coffee in the morning. Maybe I'll have a protein bar while I'm driving between sales calls, and then just something small at night. Like some grilled chicken, but without the rice or anything. 

It's just that... if I sit down and actually eat a full meal, it feels like I completely messed up the whole day. So it's easier to just keep it strict.
Has a healthcare professional told you that your current weight is medically underweight?
No, no one has told me that. I mean... I haven't really been to a regular doctor for a physical or anything in a while. So, yeah, it hasn't come up with a professional.
When you look at your body, do you feel overweight or believe you need to lose weight even when other people say you look too thin?

Yeah, I do. It doesn't really matter what other people say. Like, when I look in the mirror before a sales meeting or a date, I just zero right in on my stomach and my face. If I think I look soft at all, I just... I feel like people are going to look at me and see me as sloppy or weak. So, yeah, I definitely feel like I need to keep losing weight to fix that.
Would you be willing to have your height and weight measured today?
Yeah, I guess that's fine. I don't really love the idea of stepping on a scale right now, but... if you need to do it for the appointment, I can do that.
What is your current measured weight?
I'm not exactly sure, honestly. Like I said, I haven't been to a doctor in a long time, so I don't have an official number to give you right now. I guess we'll just have to see what your scale says.
What weight did the scale show today?
I'm not sure, to be honest. I actually looked away when I stepped on it. I just... didn't really want to see the number right now. Did the nurse write it down for you?
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No, I don't do that. I've never tried to make myself throw up after a meal or anything like that.
Do you ever have episodes when you eat an unusually large amount of food and feel unable to stop?
No, I don't. I've never really had a time where I ate a huge amount of food like that. I pretty much always know exactly what I'm eating, so I don't ever feel out of control or unable to stop.
Do you know approximately how much you currently weigh in pounds or kilograms?
No, I really don't. Like I mentioned a minute ago, I've been avoiding looking at the scale, so I don't have an exact number or even a good estimate for you right now.
Since the divorce, have you felt persistently sad or depressed most of the day on most days?

No, not really. I mean, obviously the divorce was stressful to go through, but I wouldn't say I feel sad or depressed most of the day. I'm usually just focused on work and... other things. So, no, I don't really feel like that.
Did today’s measurements show that your weight is medically below the healthy range for your height?

Well, yeah, I suppose they did. Honestly, I'm really only here because HR at work and my sister keep saying I've gotten way too thin. I don't really see it like that, though. From my side, I just see that my suits are fitting a lot sharper now, and... well, my weight has just kept dropping since the divorce. So, yeah, I guess the numbers today showed it's below that healthy range.
